integrity: Proof uses an exact finite-field quotient and power criterion, with reproducible standalone Python checker; not independently reviewed.
scientific_limitations: Only the reduced support of Weierstrass points on the specific smooth projective genus-19 curve over F_121; no Weierstrass multiplicities, arbitrary twists, other q, or universal family classification. Exhaustive identification of the geometric support is imported, with credit, from the complete 2023 semigroup classification. The Frobenius descent is checked separately by exact finite-field arithmetic. Unindexed earlier computations and later published revisions remain priority risks.
title: Cubic Frobenius descent of every nonrational Weierstrass point on the genus-19 maximal curve over \(\mathbb F_{121}\)
